scenes.script: Priya says: Aap bina kisi darr ke real-life situations, jaise ek important job-interview, ki practice kar sakte hain. Priya says: Bahut se logon ko public mein English bolne mein sharm aati hai, par Miss Nova ke saath yeh hesitation bilkul gayab ho jati hai. Priya says: Un feeds ko ghanton scroll karna band karein jo aapko bolna nahi sikhaate. Priya says: Bas din mein 15 minutes dijiye. Consistent practice ke saath, aapko lagbhag 1 month mein visible progress dikhne lagegi. Priya says: Abhi download karein Supernova AI. Priya says: Aur finally confidence ke saath English bolna shuru karein.

parsed.self_critique_fixed: The translation successfully applies all global rules. The hook opens with the native word 'Agar' to satisfy T7. Code-mixing is naturally maintained throughout using standard WhatsApp-style Romanized Hindi. Politeness matches the warm 'aap' register for Miss Nova and viewer-facing lines. The language self-reference has been correctly localized to 'Hindi' in Scene 4.

violations.quote: Miss Nova ke saath yeh hesitation bilkul gayab ho jati hai
violations.why: The brand voice promises that hesitation will completely disappear, which constitutes an absolute outcome guarantee.
violations.fix: Change to 'Miss Nova ke saath aapka hesitation kam hone lagega' to frame it as a progress expectation.

violations.quote: Miss Nova ke saath hesitation gayab
violations.why: The on-screen text guarantees that hesitation will disappear, violating the ban on brand-voiced outcome promises.
violations.fix: Change to 'Miss Nova ke saath hesitation door karein' to avoid guaranteeing an absolute end-state.

safety.summary: The ad is highly compliant overall, but contains two severe violations under G1.1 due to promising that hesitation will completely disappear.
